## Source and method

- https://developers.google.com/health/data-types

Every data type in Google's Google Health API data-types table (https://developers.google.com/health/data-types), read on 2026-10-31, joined to the v4 discovery document (https://health.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v4, revision 20261030). Name, dataType id, filter parameter, record type, storage resolution, the webhook and true-zeros badges, the v4beta tag, operations, scopes and compatible devices are copied from Google's table; field names and rollup fields from the discovery document's schemas; the Fitbit Web API predecessor from Google's migration mapping table. Three columns are DERIVED and keep their evidence: scopes are the prefix Google's Scopes page states plus the suffix the table prints; methods pair each table operation with the discovery document's method (case-insensitively, and "update" with patch only because Google's endpoint-mapping table maps updates to patch); dataPointProperty is the DataPoint field whose description names the type (dataPointEvidence, verbatim) or, where that description names none, the field DataPoint.name's kebab-case rule picks (dataPointMatch says which). flags lists the kinds of disagreement found between Google's own pages for the type; the pages show each one with the texts that disagree.

| Field | Description | JSON types | Null in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataType` | The hyphenated id Google uses in endpoint URLs | string | 0 of 44 rows |
| `name` | Not described in the dataset's fields dictionary. | string | 0 of 44 rows |

| `recordType` | Interval, Sample, Daily, Session or Food, as Google's table prints it | string | 0 of 44 rows |
| `storageResolution` | Google's storage resolution; null where the table states none | null, string | 32 of 44 rows |

| `methods` | DERIVED: the users.dataTypes.dataPoints methods those operations map to | string | 0 of 44 rows |
| `scopes` | DERIVED: full scope URLs (Google's documented prefix + the printed suffix) | string | 0 of 44 rows |
| `dataPointProperty` | DERIVED: the DataPoint field for the type; null where neither discovery document has one | null, string | 2 of 44 rows |
| `dataPointMatch` | How dataPointProperty was matched: description or kebab-case rule | null, string | 2 of 44 rows |

A null means the source does not state the value or it could not be verified. It never means zero, and it is never a guess. In the CSV a null is an empty unquoted field.

## Update cadence

- `src/data/googleHealthApi.ts` is generated by `scripts/fetch-google-health-api.mjs` from the sources above, last read 2026-10-31.
- `.github/workflows/google-health-api.yml` runs it on the schedule `52 5 * * 3` (cron, UTC).
- The files are rebuilt by `npm run datasets` (scripts/build-datasets.mjs); a run with no source change writes byte-identical files. The edition stays 2026.1, and a new edition ships under a new file name rather than overwriting this one.
